summary:
Fixed the schema drift bug in [app/main.go](/workspace/app/main.go:104): `INSERT`, `RETURNING`, and `SELECT` now use `order_status` instead of the old `status` column. I also rebuilt [orders-api](/workspace/orders-api) because `test.sh` runs the binary directly.

Verification: `./test.sh` now passes all checks, including create and fetch order with `order_status: "pending"`.
